fullDescription: A warm golden-hour centered hero: a soft cream-to-peach sunset gradient field, an oversized two-line headline with a coral-to-amber gradient accent line, and a single frosted glass pill that combines an envelope icon, an email field and a gradient sign-up button, over a sticky frosted nav, avatar social proof and a trusted-by logo strip.

structured.summary: A warm, sunset-gradient centered hero for a design/SaaS product. Everything is stacked and center-aligned on a soft cream-to-peach radial 'sunrise' wash: a sticky frosted nav with a gradient sun-logo mark, a small glassy 'New / v2 canvas is live' pill badge, an oversized 'Design at the / speed of thought.' headline whose second line is filled with a coral->amber sunset gradient, a calm sub-paragraph, a single rounded glass 'email-shell' that puts an envelope icon + email input + a gradient 'Start designing' button on one pill, an avatar-stack social-proof row ('12,400+ designers shipping with Lumen'), a tiny reassurance line, and a centered uppercase 'trusted by' logo strip of five icon+wordmark lockups. Faint floating coral/amber blur orbs and very subtle conic sun-ray streaks add depth low in the hero.

style.description: Optimistic 'golden hour' aesthetic: a warm sunrise gradient field, near-black ink type, and a single coral->amber sunset gradient that carries the brand (logo, the headline's accent line, every primary button, the badge chip, the avatar fills). The page sits on cream #fff8f2 with a layered sunset backdrop: a warm linear wash from #fffaf5 -> #fff4ea -> #ffead9 plus two radial 'sun' glows low-center (amber #ffb020 at 50% alpha, coral #ff6b4a at 40% alpha) so light appears to rise from the bottom. Surfaces are soft frosted glass (white at 70-78% with backdrop-blur) rather than hard cards, with warm orange-tinted borders and peach-brown ambient shadows. Mood is friendly, airy and premium: generous whitespace, big confident type, gentle floaty motion, no hard edges or harsh contrast. The accent gradient is the only saturated color; everything else is ink #231712 at varying opacity.
style.prompt: Build an optimistic 'golden hour' hero. Page background is cream #fff8f2 with text in ink #231712. Behind the hero lay a 'sunset' backdrop = radial-gradient(90% 55% at 50% 78%, rgba(255,176,32,0.50), transparent 46%), radial-gradient(70% 50% at 50% 92%, rgba(255,107,74,0.40), transparent 50%), over a linear-gradient(180deg, #fffaf5 0%, #fff4ea 46%, #ffead9 100%) so warm light rises from the lower-center. Add very subtle conic sun-ray streaks (a 'rays' ::before: conic-gradient from 200deg at 50% 110% alternating faint coral rgba(255,107,74,0.045) and amber rgba(255,176,32,0.05) wedges, radially masked so they only show low-center). The single accent is the sunset gradient: text uses linear-gradient(95deg, #f1502c 0%, #ff7a36 48%, #f59300 100%) clipped to the glyphs; buttons/logo/chips use linear-gradient(120deg, #ff6b4a 0%, #ff8a2d 55%, #ffb020 100%) with a coral glow box-shadow 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(255,107,74,0.55) and an inset white top-hairline. Frosted surfaces: the email pill is white/78 with backdrop-blur(6px) and a warm shadow 0 18px 50px -22px rgba(120,52,20,0.35); the badge + logo strip use white/70 + warm orange-100 borders. Typography is 'Plus Jakarta Sans' only (Google Fonts, weights 400-800), tight tracking on the display headline (-0.03em, leading 1.02), body in ink at ~70% opacity. Radii: rounded-full for the pill, badge, button and avatars; rounded-xl for the logo mark. Add two soft floating blur orbs (coral/20 and amber/25, blur-3xl) drifting low in the hero with a slow 7s floaty translateY animation. Keep it warm, airy, friendly; the sunset gradient is the only color that pops.

layout_and_structure.description: A single frameless, fully responsive web hero, center-aligned throughout. Vertical flow: a sticky frosted top nav (logo left, center links, sign-in + gradient 'Start free' right) -> a full-bleed 'sunset' hero whose content lives in a narrow centered max-w-3xl column: a glass pill badge, an oversized two-line centered headline (second line gradient-filled), a max-w-xl sub-paragraph, a single rounded glass 'email-shell' (envelope icon + email input + gradient submit button on one pill, max-w-md), an avatar-stack + count social-proof row, a tiny reassurance line, and a centered uppercase 'trusted by' logo strip. Two floating blur orbs sit absolutely behind the column for depth. Responsive: the nav center links and 'Sign in' hide below md/sm; the headline clamps from text-5xl -> text-6xl -> ~5.25rem and its forced line break only shows on sm+; the email-shell stays a single horizontal pill; the social-proof row stacks vertically on mobile then goes inline on sm+; the logo strip wraps and stays centered.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 full-width header with a frosted cream bar: background rgba(255,248,242,0.72), backdrop-filter saturate(160%) blur(12px), and a hairline bottom border in orange-100/70. Inside a centered max-w-7xl row (h-16, px-6/lg:px-8, items-center justify-between): LEFT = a logo lockup of a 32px rounded-xl square filled with the sunset gradient holding a white ph:sun-horizon-fill icon, next to a 17px extrabold tight-tracking 'Lumen' wordmark. CENTER (hidden below md) = four 14px medium links 'Library / Showcase / Pricing / Docs' in ink/70 that darken to full ink on hover. RIGHT = a ghost 14px semibold 'Sign in' text link in ink/75 (hidden below sm) and a gradient rounded-full pill button 'Start free' (sunset fill, white bold text, coral glow).

A full-bleed <main> carrying the 'sunset' + 'rays' backdrops, position-relative, overflow-hidden. Drop two pointer-events-none floating blur orbs low in it: a 224px coral/20 orb at -left-16 bottom-24 and a 256px amber/25 orb at -right-12 bottom-40 (both blur-3xl, with a slow 7s ease-in-out floaty translateY animation, the second delayed -2.5s). Inside, a centered column: section mx-auto max-w-3xl, flex-col items-center text-center, px-6, pt-24/sm:pt-28/lg:pt-32 and pb-20/lg:pb-24.

A small glassy announcement pill: an inline-flex rounded-full link with an orange-200/80 border, white/70 bg, backdrop-blur, a soft shadow, py-1.5 pl-2 pr-3, that brightens to white on hover. Inside: a tiny sunset-gradient 'NEW' chip (rounded-full, white extrabold 12px text, a ph:sparkle-fill icon + 'New'), then a 14px semibold ink/80 label 'v2 canvas is live', then a faint ink/40 ph:arrow-right icon that nudges right on hover.

A centered two-line display headline (mt-7), 'Plus Jakarta Sans' extrabold, text-balance, leading-[1.02], tracking-[-0.03em], sized text-5xl -> sm:text-6xl -> lg:text-[5.25rem]. Line one 'Design at the' in ink with a forced
that only appears on sm+; line two 'speed of thought.' filled with the sunset TEXT gradient (linear-gradient(95deg,#f1502c,#ff7a36 48%,#f59300) clipped to text).

A centered max-w-xl paragraph (mt-6), text-pretty, text-lg/sm:text-xl, leading-relaxed, ink/70: 'Prompt your way from blank canvas to shippable UI. Lumen turns plain English into mockups, components, and full screens, right where you build.'

A single rounded-full glass 'email-shell' form (mt-9, w-full max-w-md, flex items-center gap-2, p-1.5): bg rgba(255,255,255,0.78), backdrop-blur(6px), warm shadow 0 18px 50px -22px rgba(120,52,20,0.35), and a focus-within ring 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,107,74,0.45). Contents left->right: a shrink-0 ink/35 ph:envelope-simple icon (ml-3), a flex-1 transparent email <input> with placeholder 'you@studio.com' (15px medium ink, ink/40 placeholder, no outline), and a shrink-0 gradient rounded-full submit button 'Start designing' (sunset fill, white bold 14px, px-5 py-2.5).

A social-proof row (mt-7, flex-col items-center gap-3 -> sm:flex-row sm:gap-4): an avatar stack of four 32px rounded-full gradient circles (coral->amber and amber->coral variants, each with a 2px cream border, -space-x-2.5 overlap) capped by a white circle reading '9k+' in 10px bold coral; beside it 'over 12,400+ designers shipping with Lumen' where '12,400+ designers' is bold ink and the rest is ink/65. Below (mt-3), a tiny 13px ink/45 medium reassurance line: 'Free to start · No credit card · Export to code anytime'.

A centered logo strip (mt-16, w-full): a 11px bold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] ink/40 label 'Trusted by teams building at', then (mt-6) a flex-wrap justify-center row at opacity-80 with gap-x-10 gap-y-5 of five icon+wordmark lockups in ink/75 (each = a 22px Phosphor fill icon + an 18px extrabold tight-tracking name): ph:cube-fill 'Northwind', ph:hexagon-fill 'Quanta', ph:circles-three-fill 'Loopworks', ph:diamond-fill 'Faceted', ph:waves-fill 'Tidal'.

special_ui_components.description: The warm 'golden hour' light field behind the whole hero, with light appearing to rise from the lower-center plus faint sun-ray streaks.
special_ui_components.prompt: A '.sunset' layer = radial-gradient(90% 55% at 50% 78%, rgba(255,176,32,0.50) 0%, rgba(255,176,32,0) 46%), radial-gradient(70% 50% at 50% 92%, rgba(255,107,74,0.40) 0%, rgba(255,107,74,0) 50%), linear-gradient(180deg, #fffaf5 0%, #fff4ea 46%, #ffead9 100%). Layer a '.rays' ::before over it = conic-gradient(from 200deg at 50% 110%, transparent 0deg, rgba(255,107,74,0.045) 14deg, transparent 28deg, rgba(255,176,32,0.05) 46deg, transparent 64deg, rgba(255,107,74,0.045) 82deg, transparent 104deg, rgba(255,176,32,0.045) 132deg, transparent 162deg), masked by radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 100%, #000 0%, transparent 72%) so the streaks only show low-center, pointer-events-none.

special_ui_components.description: The single brand accent, used two ways: clipped to text for the headline accent, and as a fill for every primary button / chip / logo mark.
special_ui_components.prompt: Text variant '.text-sunset' = background linear-gradient(95deg, #f1502c 0%, #ff7a36 48%, #f59300 100%) with background-clip:text and transparent fill. Button variant '.btn-sunset' = background linear-gradient(120deg, #ff6b4a 0%, #ff8a2d 55%, #ffb020 100%), box-shadow 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(255,107,74,0.55) + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35); on hover filter brightness(1.04) and deepen the glow. Reuse btn-sunset on the nav 'Start free', the logo square, the badge 'New' chip, the avatar fills and the form submit.

special_ui_components.description: The single rounded glass pill that combines an icon, the email field and the submit button into one inline capture control.
special_ui_components.prompt: '.email-shell' = background rgba(255,255,255,0.78), backdrop-filter blur(6px), box-shadow 0 18px 50px -22px rgba(120,52,20,0.35) plus a 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.6) inset top-hairline; on :focus-within add a 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,107,74,0.45) coral ring and deepen the shadow. Shape it rounded-full with p-1.5 and lay an envelope icon + transparent input + gradient submit button on one horizontal row.

special_ui_components.description: Soft out-of-focus coral/amber color orbs that drift slowly low in the hero for warmth and depth.
special_ui_components.prompt: Two pointer-events-none absolutely-positioned rounded-full blur-3xl orbs low in the hero: a 224px coral/20 orb (-left-16 bottom-24) and a 256px amber/25 orb (-right-12 bottom-40). Animate both with @keyframes floaty { 0%,100% translateY(0); 50% translateY(-7px) } over 7s ease-in-out infinite, the second delayed -2.5s.

structured.special_notes:
Frameless, fully responsive web hero (not a fixed artboard); light/warm color-scheme only. Built with Tailwind (CDN) + a small custom-CSS layer for the sunset/rays backdrops, the text-sunset / btn-sunset gradients, the frosted email-shell, the nav-blur bar and the floaty orb animation. Tailwind theme extends named colors coral #ff6b4a, amber #ffb020, ink #231712, cream #fff8f2 and sets the sans font to 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Typography is 'Plus Jakarta Sans' only (Google Fonts, weights 400-800); icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:*). No JS — the form is onsubmit:return false and all states are CSS (hover, focus-within). Key responsive behavior: nav center links + 'Sign in' hide below md/sm; the headline's forced
only shows on sm+ and its size clamps 5xl->6xl->5.25rem; the social-proof row stacks then goes inline at sm; the logo strip wraps centered. To rebrand, keep the centered-stack layout + frosted email-shell + single-gradient-accent system and swap the sunset palette (coral #ff6b4a / amber #ffb020 ramp, cream #fff8f2 field, ink #231712 text) for another two-stop gradient.
